_help: Copy this file into a new folder under episodes/, next to master.wav and the cousins' clips. Delete lines you don't need.
_follow_lag_help: seconds. More negative = animation earlier, closer to 0 or positive = later. Try steps of 0.05 to 0.1
_style_options: staircase, karaoke, bignote, falling, pitchtrail, gauge, pads, arcs
_cousin_look_options: cutout = cousins are cut out of their background and stand on the animation's background; stacked = plain video strip under the animation
_cutout_focus_help: 0 keeps the top of the cousins' frame, 1 the bottom. Raise it if heads are cut off or too much empty space shows above.
